mentions.name: WallMod
mentions.description: A local, static-image wallpaper manager that handles desktop backgrounds from directories of images, similar to Wallpaper Engine but for image folders. Available for Windows and Linux.
mentions.problem: Windows' built-in wallpaper/background management is horrible.

mentions.name: WallMod
mentions.description: WallMod is a desktop wallpaper manager, modifier, and auto-setter tailored specifically to static images, similar to Wallpaper Engine but focused on static wallpapers rather than animated ones.
mentions.problem: Existing wallpaper tools like Wallpaper Engine center on animated wallpapers, whereas the builder prefers static images.
mentions.source_excerpt: "WallMod" -> wallpaper manager and modifier and autosetter. Kinda like wallpaper engine but instead tailored specifically to static images since I don't like animated ones personally. https://github.com/DefrimBinakaj/WallMod
